adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,` around the evt construction). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which becomes a silent no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null`. Since `teamDestinationCalendars` is populated from other hosts’ `user.destinationCalendar` values, this means those host calendars are never added to `evt.destinationCalendar`, and downstream logic (`createAllCalendarEvents` checks `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`) will not process those destinations. Other migrated call sites in the diff use `[]` instead of `null`, so this is an inconsistent initialization that can drop the intended calendars without any error.
